transitions.picture: Fade up from black over the aerial.
transitions.sound: Start the drone and the struck bell 12 frames before picture, in black.

transitions.picture: Hard cut. The spinning mountain cuts straight to the stain.
transitions.sound: Smash the sound. Every layer stops on the cut and only the wide hiss remains.

transitions.picture: Dissolve, 16 frames, from the untouched feet to the line of claimants. It is a jump in time; let it read as one.
transitions.sound: Let the sub drop ring out under the dissolve, then bring in the shingle and cloth of the crowd.

transitions.picture: Match dissolve, 24 frames. The garland rising toward the empty hands becomes the painted wall. Line up the hands with the painted hand at the gate (centre-right) so the myth turns into the painting. Use this as the trailer's signature transition.
transitions.sound: The distant bell carries across. The broom fades in under the second half.

transitions.picture: Dip to black, 6 frames out and 6 in, between movement I and movement II.
transitions.sound: Finger on plaster, then silence in the black. The hall's murmur starts on the first frame of picture.

transitions.picture: Smash cut from her last word straight to the ink macro, with no breath between them.
transitions.sound: The bass flute enters on the first frame of T-06. This is the first music in the trailer.

transitions.picture: Dissolve, 18 frames: the letter disappearing into cloth becomes first light on the road. Night to dawn, room to country.
transitions.sound: Bring the wind at altitude in under the dissolve; the flute continues.

transitions.picture: Six frames of black, then a hard cut in. Movement II gives way to III.
transitions.sound: The percussion enters on the first frame of T-08, exactly on the frame drum. Make sure nothing is playing in the black.

transitions.picture: Hard cut. The T-10 chalk and siege run is cut strictly on the beat, so don't add any transitions inside it.
transitions.sound: Lay the chalk strokes on the drum beats. If a shot is 12 to 14 frames, keep it that length.

transitions.picture: Cut on the end of Jarasandha's line to the burning hillside.
transitions.sound: L-cut: let his last word run 8 frames over the fire. The drums come back to full under the fire roar.

transitions.picture: Smash cut to the dropped sword.
transitions.sound: Kill all the sound one frame before the camera stops, as the sheet says. The drums stop dead on T-12.

transitions.picture: Hard cut on the downbeat: the sea gate rising. If the beat wants a flash, add 2 frames of white, otherwise none.
transitions.sound: The full ensemble enters on the first frame of T-13.

transitions.picture: Dip to black, 9 frames out and 9 in. Movement IV begins in one quiet room.
transitions.sound: Strip everything back to the single sustained note. Start it in the black.

transitions.picture: Cut on the first conch to the crane over the procession.
transitions.sound: The conch is diegetic and arrives a frame early (a J-cut).

transitions.picture: Hard cut onto the temple threshold.
transitions.sound: Let the sound drop away ACROSS this cut, a 20-frame fade that starts 10 frames before it, not on the cut.

transitions.picture: Hard cut on the frame her foot leaves the stone.
transitions.sound: The full ensemble comes in on the cut; the solo voice ends exactly there.

transitions.picture: Cut to black on the conch. Don't fade it.
transitions.sound: The conch runs 2 seconds past the cut into the black and into the title.

transitions.picture: Title fades in over 12 frames, holds, and fades out 12 frames into black.
transitions.sound: One struck bell 1.5 s into the title.

transitions.picture: Rukmini's line plays over black, then cut to the logos.
transitions.sound: No music under the line; room tone only.
